questions.question_text: From this list write down the square number. 8, 27, 49, 51, 53, 55, 99
Write each number in standard form. (a) 28010
Write each number in standard form. (b) 0.100209
Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 170°. Find the number of sides of this polygon.
Xian walks 8 km in 1 1/2 hours. She then runs 10 km in 45 minutes. Find her average speed in km/h for the whole journey.
AB = AC. Find the value of x.
The lengths of the sides of a right-angled triangle are 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm. Find the tangent of the smallest angle.
Magda buys 6 apples and 4 oranges for a total cost of $4.18. Oranges cost $0.52 each. Find the cost of one apple.
The mean of five numbers is 16. When two extra numbers are included the mean of the seven numbers is 20. Find the mean of the two extra numbers.
The point A has co-ordinates (1, -5) and the point B has co-ordinates (9, 1). Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of AB in the form y = mx + c.
Rationalise the denominator and simplify your answer. \frac{14}{3 - \sqrt{2}}
Rearrange the formula to make x the subject. y = 1 - \frac{x}{3x - 5}
An archer fires three arrows at a target. The probability that the archer hits the target with each arrow is 3/5. Find the probability that the archer hits the target exactly twice.
